dex.text: A chalk-white standing stone that was here before the church and fully intends to be here after it. On still nights small lights drift round it, as if someone is still visiting.
dex.fact: The Rudston Monolith in East Yorkshire is the tallest standing stone in Britain, about 7.6 metres high. It was raised around 4,000 years ago from gritstone brought from the coast some ten miles away, and All Saints Church was built right beside it.
